capabilities: Toggle checkbox states from a right-click context menu
Define custom checkbox states with character, label, and icon
Style each state with distinct colors and glyphs using theme variables
Cycle through enabled states with a command and hotkey
Configure which states appear in the menu and how it looks
extras: State styling details are documented separately in docs/status-styles.md rather than in the README.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that adds a right-click context menu to any task checkbox for switching between states
problem: Obsidian's task checkboxes only toggle between unchecked and done, so intermediate states like deferred, scheduled, or cancelled have no built-in way to be set.
summary: Task checkbox context menu that toggles between built-in and custom states in Live Preview, Reading mode, and via a cycle command.
